title: Assertion Detail Sprawl
pattern: Assertions that verify exact string matches, formatting, whitespace, or irrelevant fields that are not part of the functional contract under test.
why_bad: It causes high test fragility [269, 572]. Simple, harmless formatting or text changes (e.g., tweaking logging layout) break tests across the suite, leading to refactoring friction [269, 572].
detection: Assertions checking exact string matches containing volatile data (timestamps, absolute file paths, formatted messages) [269, 572].
fix: Build custom domain-specific assertion methods or simplify expectations to assert strictly on core stable invariants rather than presentation formatting [269, 572].
source:
*   *The Pragmatic Programmer*, "Unreliable things / Fragile tests" (p. 269) [269, 572]
*   *Clean Code*, "Avoid details / Expressive assertions" (p. 127) [70, 72]
